source_lineage.conversion_readme: Case Study L Simulation Triad Experiment README (v1.0)

modulation.description: Models modulation between system-level operational surfaces and manifold structural geometry using bounded structural channels.

cross_surface_alignment.description: Routes and aligns structural flows between system and manifold surfaces without expressive geometry.

gating.description: Applies manifold-layer gating across system-manifold interaction surfaces.

stabilization.description: Maintains stable interaction geometry during system-to-manifold transitions and modulation cycles.

dissipation.description: Models dissipation of interaction intensity within bounded simulation envelopes.

residual_looping.description: Models residual looping behavior within interaction basins formed by system-manifold modulation.

non_activation_clause.description: This behavioral model is structural-only. It does not activate, simulate, or bind any NDH subsystem, expressive geometry mechanism, holonomy operator, or manifold process.
